question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Fullfil**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling of the word is "**Fulfil**" with only one "**l**".
 
• The incorrect spelling of the word "**Fullfil**" has an extra "**l**" added.
 
• The word "**Fulfil**" means to bring to completion or to satisfy a requirement. (किसी आवश्यकता को पूरा करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *He worked hard to fulfil his dreams of success.*
 
 

Thus,** option 4** is the correct answer.
